name: Permanent Residence (RP-1)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires the original temporary residence card plus 4 annual renewals (read as roughly 5 years of continuous temporary residence) before applying for Permanent Residence.
requirements.fix_path: Hold and renew a temporary residence card annually for 5 years.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a bank letter showing a minimum RD$150,000 balance, or an insurance guarantee policy if solvency is insufficient.

evidence_required.document: Original temporary residence card with 4 prior renewals
Criminal background certificate with QR code
Change-of-category letter to the Director General

outcome.duration_length: Indefinite card, subject to Definitive Residence (RD-1) upgrade after 10 years

sources.title: Dirección General de Migración -- Permanent Residence Application (RP-1): original card plus 4 temporary residence renewals required, RD$150,000 solvency, RD$16,800 fee, 90 working days

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Dominican Republic). The '4 renewals' language is not stated as an explicit year count on the DGM page -- read as ~5 years total (1 initial card + 4 annual renewals) since every temporary residence category in this dataset for the Dominican Republic (RT-3, RT-9, investor, rentista, pensionado) is issued for 1 year at a time. This is an interpretive judgment call, flagged explicitly rather than presented as a stated figure. citizenship_after_months (24) reflects the Ordinary Naturalization requirement of 2 years as a Permanent Resident -- see do_naturalisation.json. This RP-1 status is distinct from, and precedes, Definitive Residence (RD-1), which requires a further 10 years as a Permanent Resident (see do_definitive_residence.json) -- RP-1 already carries full work/study rights and is itself sufficient to pursue naturalization after 2 more years, so RD-1 is not a prerequisite for citizenship in this dataset's modeling.
